Status.note: The national power plant list from the Bundesnetzagentur, dated 26 June 2026, lists Irsching 3 under the operator Uniper as finally closed under section 13b of the energy law. It shows 415 MW net, started in 1974, closed in 2024. Uniper's own plant page says the oil-fired unit 3 had been held in grid reserve since 2012 and that final closure would take place on 31 December 2023. Uniper's page has not been updated to say the closure happened, so the actual closure rests on the register. This is a change from mothballed, and only the register confirms that the closure took place, so I rate it medium.

Retired year.note: The national power plant list dated 26 June 2026 gives a closure year of 2024 for Irsching 3. Uniper's plant page and a trade news item from December 2022 planned final closure for 31 December 2023. Press searches say the grid operator's system relevance ran until 31 March 2024. The sources do not agree on the year, so a researcher should decide.

Latest Activity.note: The newest dated event is the final closure. The national power plant list dated 26 June 2026 gives the closure year as 2024 and no month.

Status Detail.value: Held in grid reserve for the grid operator TenneT from 2012. Returned to the market from February 2023 under the replacement power plant law. Listed as finally closed in 2024 in the national power plant list.
Status Detail.note: A trade news item from December 2022 says the unit was in the grid reserve and would return to the market from February 2023 until the end of 2023. The national power plant list dated 26 June 2026 lists it as finally closed.
